title: The bag that copies
notes: Keep one adult at each table and reset every fresh story to the same two original counters. First routes: K-1 P1-2; grades 2-3 P1-2; grades 4-5 P1, then P2-3. On return, K-1 can find four-draw stories or work backward one step (P3-4). Grades 2-3 can compare return-only sampling and reordered words (P3-4), then larger final bags (P5-6). Grades 4-5 can make the 24-history argument (P4), the four-draw count (P5), or pursue the arbitrary-length conjecture (P6). Keep exact history counts distinct from trial frequencies.
